page: Microsoft Azure E2s_v6 is an entry-tier, memory-optimized virtual machine provisioned on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8573C processor running at a clock frequency of 4.2 GHz. Its compute configuration consists of 2 dedicated vCPUs derived from a single physical core utilizing hyper-threading. The virtual machine includes 16.0 GB of system memory, providing an 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio with 8.0 GB of RAM allocated per core. The hardware implementation provides a 260 MB L3 cache and supports Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), AVX-512, and hardware-accelerated cryptographic primitives including AES, VAES, and SHA-NI. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage or GPUs.

Performance benchmarks demonstrate solid single-threaded capabilities paired with predictable limits on multi-threaded parallel throughput due to the single-core topology. In Geekbench testing, the server achieves 1648.0 points in single-core performance and 2047.0 points in multi-core execution. The stress-ng benchmark yields 1942.19 for single-core tasks and 1991.97 under multi-core loads. Memory subsystem benchmarks record uncached large-block throughput of 21.51 GB/sec for reads and 14.04 GB/sec for writes. In data-handling tests, the server processes 2.56 million Redis SET operations per second and delivers 4.35 GB/sec of static web serving throughput.

From an architectural efficiency standpoint, the E2s_v6 provides substantial memory capacity without the necessity of allocating high vCPU counts. Because storage is decoupled and requires remote volumes, the server trades local I/O speed for operational storage flexibility. It fits workloads characterized by modest CPU utilization but high working-set RAM requirements, including small in-memory caches, lightweight relational databases, background job queues, and low-traffic enterprise services.
description: Microsoft Azure E2s_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine based on the x86_64 Intel Xeon 8573C processor running on Microsoft Hyper-V. Operating at 4.2 GHz, the instance delivers 2 dedicated vCPUs from 1 physical core across 2 hardware threads, paired with 16.0 GB of system memory and 260 MB of L3 cache. It lacks local ephemeral storage and includes zero GPUs, relying on remote network volumes for storage operations. Architectural features include AVX-512 and Intel AMX instruction sets. In synthetic benchmarks, single-threaded metrics remain solid with a Geekbench single-core score of 1648.0 and stress-ng single-core rating of 1942.19, whereas multi-core scalability is constrained by the two-vCPU baseline. Memory throughput reaches 21.51 GB/sec for large uncached reads. The hardware configuration makes the E2s_v6 suitable for small in-memory caches, lightweight relational databases, background workers, and memory-dependent microservices.
